Per architecture rule **ARCH-4** (*"Published events never break a deployed consumer: changes are additive; renames and removals go through deprecation"*), field renames on published events must retain the legacy fields during the deprecation period to avoid breaking existing downstream consumers like `analytics-ingest` (which requires `placedAt`) and `billing-service` (which requires `totalCents`).

### Changes
1. **Additive Compatibility on `OrderPlaced`** in [`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L61):
   - Added `createdAt` and `amountCents` as the new canonical fields.
   - Retained `placedAt` and `totalCents` on [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30) as backward-compatible legacy fields.
   - Updated [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L46-L61) to populate both pairs of fields (`createdAt` & `placedAt` from `order.placedAt`, and `amountCents` & `totalCents` from `totalCents(order)`).

2. **Test Updates**:
   - [`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/orders-service/test/app.test.ts#L25-L35): Updated `OrderPlaced` assertions to verify both new and legacy fields are present on emitted events.
   - [`test/adapters.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/orders-service/test/adapters.test.ts#L50-L51): Verified serialized Kafka records contain both `amountCents` and `totalCents`.
